topics.title: Harry’s Second Marriage & School Principal Troubles
topics.summary: Funny Harry abruptly ends his first marriage to marry Leona, an older woman who frequently threatens him with withheld sex. He then becomes embroiled in a controversy involving Joseph Fernandez, the new school chancellor, and misguided ideas about segregating students based on behavior. Teachers have more authority and one teacher uses dance lessons and pledge of allegiance instruction.

They delve into a range of cinematic choices – from ‘Prince of Darkness’ to ‘American Ninja’– often expressing opinions on the movies' merits while also commenting on actors, storylines, and speculating about potential casting for future projects. topics.title: Saturday Night Reunion Chaos
topics.summary: During an impromptu gathering with Don Novello and Father Guido Sarducci, a chaotic conversation unfolds involving celebrity encounters, missed lines in Saturday Night Live sketches, and bizarre observations about guests like Irving Berliner. Guests discuss setting tables on fire, confusing interactions with celebrities, and the strange behavior of attendees at a reunion show.

topics.title: Backstage Chaos at SNL Reunion
topics.summary: A chaotic reunion show features numerous celebrity guests backstage at Saturday Night Live, including Eric Idol and Prince. Awkward interactions occur with figures like Garrett Morris, who is viewed as an outsider, while Chevy Chase exhibits difficult behavior. Guests express confusion over the event’s organization and a bizarre tuxedo-clad audience.
